question: On an average day, which takes Americans the most time: watching TV, eating, socialising in person or reading?
answer: Television, by far: about 2.7 hours a day, more than half of all leisure time, in the American Time Use Survey. Socialising in person gets under 40 minutes, reading about a quarter of an hour. Free time drains into whatever needs no plan or effort; the things people say they value need both.
move: Days drain into whatever needs no choosing; schedule what you value.
source: US Bureau of Labor Statistics, American Time Use Survey
reference: US Bureau of Labor Statistics (2024) American Time Use Survey: 2023 Results, news release
